title: Bind the ProjectOne repository and record OD-01 disposition
rationale: The Profile was frozen under APR-002. Adding the repository URL and the owner's GitHub execution decision is a change to a frozen artifact and therefore requires a governed change package with a new version — not an in-place edit. Editing the frozen profile directly would invalidate the freeze manifest, which is exactly the defect class F-R7-02 caught.
riskBasis: Configuration binding; no security, tenant, canonical-data, or source-authority impact. No R4 or R3 trigger fires.

value.description: Owner executes all GitHub operations. The assistant produces exact commands and expected output; the owner runs them and returns actual output, which becomes the evidence record.
value.rationale: Keeps credentials and secrets entirely off the assistant platform. secret_protection is a global non-waivable invariant, so this is handled by architecture rather than by exception.
value.consequence: Steps 63-72, 91, 101 and 110 are owner-executed. No GitHub result is recorded as passing unless the owner actually ran it and returned output.

approvalBasis: R2 configuration binding within the owner's already-recorded OD-01 decision. Not a material architecture change; no non-delegable approval class applies.
evidenceRefs: Repository read confirmed: clone succeeded, 1 file, branch main, commit 79a4417
